features.title: Ask Jev one Noul question and record its usage
features.summary: Send one TypeSafe Jev classification over HttpClient with the shared request and answer schemas, return the probability and provider-reported tokens, and record every call in the usage plugin's Jev ledger.
failureModes: A non-2xx answer fails with JevStatusRejected naming the status and still records a failed call.
No answer within the caller's timeout fails with JevTimedOut and records a failed call with its duration.
An answer outside the Noul schema fails with JevAnswerInvalid.
When no plugin serves the usage API the call still answers; the usage record is dropped with a debug log.

externalDependencies.boundary: POST to api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone with one question and the caller-bounded text, authorized by the caller-resolved key.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: An HttpClient built with HttpClient.make answers fixed responses in src/jev.test.ts.

verification.testName: asks one Noul question and records a successful call with its tokens
